dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Hello, are you here to buy something as well? Huh, you aren't?

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: *sigh* I envy people like you who can show restraint when shopping...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Especially during a holiday with special sales and discounts everywhere. I even find the wine very tempting...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Ah, no. I must control myself. Resist, Eury! If I get any wine, why, it'll only end up being consumed by my alcoholic of a husband!
